description: French clean nail care brand founded in 1996, known for Green Flash LED gel polish and plant-based nail formulas, sold through its own US storefront and beauty retailers.

evidence.summary: Manucurist's Awin US merchant profile lists the affiliate program paying 20% of net sales revenue on packaged offers and 10% on individual products.

Manucurist's own US affiliate page says anyone can join for free, affiliates receive a welcome kit and followers get 15% off, with sign-up routed via Superfiliate; the page states 'Over +2,500 affiliates members around the world', so creator saturation is recorded as high, and lists affiliation@manucurist.com as the program contact.

The published rate is recorded as 10 (individual products) with the 20% packaged-offer rate and the net-sales-revenue basis documented here; no earnings-cap statement appears in any fetched source, so the cap is recorded as unknown.
Manucurist's official US storefront sells its Green Flash LED gel polish and clean nail care lines; the brand is a French clean nail brand founded in 1996.

name: Manucurist

name: Adept Cosmetics
description: Independent (indie) makeup brand known among beauty creators for its eyeshadow palettes (including the Unity Collection) and vegan, cruelty-free formulas, sold through its own website adeptcosmetics.com.

evidence.summary: Adept Cosmetics' own site hosts a 'Become An Adept Cosmetics Affiliate' page stating the program is administered through Affiliatly.

The program's Affiliatly panel states: 5% per sale on any referred purchase (new or existing customers), paid every 50 days via PayPal; commissions are earned via coupon code only, not links; affiliate codes give customers 10% off; a code must generate at least $200 a month to stay active. The panel contains no earnings-cap statement, so the cap is unknown (the $200/month figure is an activity threshold, not an earnings cap), and no creator-count evidence was found, so saturation is unknown.

The panel promises affiliates who create content with their own photos promotion on the brand's Instagram and website (notify via pr@adeptcosmetics.com or tag the brand), and top earners receive new releases for free.
Creator reviews cover Adept Cosmetics' Unity Collection palettes with 10%-off affiliate codes, confirming active creator use of the program; the brand posts as @adeptcosmetics on Instagram.

reasons.niche_fit: Indie makeup brand whose palettes are staples of creator swatch and review content — a good beauty niche fit.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The brand explicitly promotes affiliates who create content with their own photos on its Instagram and website, and top earners receive new releases free.
reasons.compensation: A published 5% per sale, paid via PayPal every 50 days; code-only tracking and a $200/month activity threshold for codes keep this modest; no cap statement found.
reasons.contact_access: A published PR email (pr@adeptcosmetics.com) plus an affiliate application page on the brand's own site.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open registration through the brand's own affiliate page and Affiliatly panel, subject to the monthly activity threshold.
reasons.credibility: A small independent brand with an engaged creator community but limited scale and press.
